implementation: Track the byte offset and physical line number of the last successfully consumed newline-terminated row; seek directly there on same-inode growth.

All ten write entry points catch up changes before mutating under the unchanged exclusive_file_lock. Own durable appends advance stat identity, offset and line number before releasing that lock, so the following read and no-op poll do no journal reads.

Explicit reload/startup, missing/replaced inode, observed shrink and same-size mtime changes rebuild all four projections. Only explicit reload/startup invokes the existing stranded-processing-receipt recovery.

Decode complete rows after checking the binary newline boundary. An incomplete tail, including partial UTF-8, stays unconsumed until completed. A local append refuses an incomplete tail instead of corrupting the next JSONL row.
Complete malformed rows retain the error and byte/physical-line position on retry. Existing per-record deserializers, fsync and directory durability semantics are retained.

acceptance_evidence.AC1: Instrumented Path.open/readline/seek verifies exact external tail bytes and zero journal reads after own writes and unchanged no-op polls.
acceptance_evidence.AC2: Two independent stores alternate run, large/ordinary receipt, watermark and queued/running/done frontier appends. Every round compares all four serialized maps against each other and a fresh full replay.
acceptance_evidence.AC3: Separate parameterized replacement, same-inode shrink, same-size rewrite and deletion cases assert full reset at offset zero; startup and existing-reader partial UTF-8 tests preserve the complete prefix until the final newline arrives.
acceptance_evidence.AC4: Startup recovery remains durable and idempotent, ordinary catch-up leaves processing receipts alone. A spawned process is blocked by the existing file lock and claims the frontier exactly once.
acceptance_evidence.AC5: 46.43 MB realistic journal, 22 registered connectors, actual local HTTP GET /api/source-ingest/registry after every 594529-byte external append; five samples with two-second pauses. Registry p50 30.95 ms versus baseline 1017.49 ms.
acceptance_evidence.AC6: Only scheduler.py changes production code; no BFF, receipt format, endpoint, cache layer or new setting changes.
acceptance_evidence.AC7: No existing test file was changed or deleted. New-test development corrected an expected seek count from 10 to 5 because only the reader needs to catch up the writer, and extended the partial-line test to a nonempty consumed prefix.

benchmark.method: Before class is the unmodified scheduler.py loaded from the exact base commit. Each variant constructs a separate identical journal using build_real_shape_journal, then runs the same production registry router and measure_registry helper. Wall: perf_counter; process CPU including HTTP worker threads: process_time. First sample included; no timing samples discarded. Idle-poll results include frontier scan but no append. Local results do not prove hosted acceptance.
benchmark.reproducer_python:
import importlib.util
import json
import platform
import tempfile
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median
from time import perf_counter, process_time

from services.source_ingestion.tests.test_ingest_schedule_incremental_replay import registry_on_journal, measure_registry
from services.source_ingestion.scheduler import JsonlIngestScheduleStore

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('services.source_ingestion._schedule_baseline', '/tmp/source-schedule-baseline.py')
import sys
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = module
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
fixture = Path('services/source_ingestion/tests/fixtures/hosted_registry_20261112.json')
captured = json.loads(fixture.read_bytes())
results = {'fixture_sha256': sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'python': platform.python_version(),
           'platform': platform.platform(), 'cpu_count': __import__('os').cpu_count(), 'variants': {}}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='schedule-benchmark-') as temp:
    for name, cls in [('before', module.JsonlIngestScheduleStore), ('after', JsonlIngestScheduleStore)]:
        runtime, client, writer = registry_on_journal(Path(temp) / name, captured, cls)
        path = runtime.SCHEDULE_STORE_PATH
        counts, sizes = {}, {}
        with path.open('rb') as handle:
            for line in handle:
                kind = json.loads(line)['record_type']
                counts[kind] = counts.get(kind, 0) + 1
                sizes[kind] = sizes.get(kind, 0) + len(line)
        initial_size = path.stat().st_size
        with client:
            metrics = measure_registry(runtime, client, writer, captured, samples=5, interval=2)
        idle_wall, idle_cpu = [], []
        for _ in range(5):
            start, cpu_start = perf_counter(), process_time()
            assert writer.claim_due_frontier(limit=1) == []
            idle_wall.append((perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
            idle_cpu.append((process_time() - cpu_start) * 1000)
        results['variants'][name] = {'initial_journal_bytes': initial_size, 'row_counts': counts,
                                   'row_bytes': sizes, 'final_journal_bytes': path.stat().st_size,
                                   'samples': 5, 'pause_before_each_append_seconds': 2,
                                   'append_bytes_per_sample': (path.stat().st_size - initial_size) // 5,
                                   'idle_poll_wall_ms': idle_wall, 'idle_poll_cpu_ms': idle_cpu,
                                   'idle_poll_p50_ms': median(idle_wall), **metrics}
        Path('/tmp/source-schedule-benchmark-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + '\n')
        print(name, json.dumps(results['variants'][name]), flush=True)
assert results['variants']['after']['registry_p50_ms'] < 300
